lines.text: Earth has gone dark, and you must choose one of four planets to survive on forever.
Planet one has endless pastel fields and warm fresh-water oceans.
The sun never sets, but the inhabitants you meet have no faces, and they speak in familiar voices.
Planet two is an infinite indoor shopping mall under humming fluorescent lights.
Food and dry shelter are everywhere, but every corridor leads back to the exact same vacant storefront.
Planet three is drowning in iron-scented fog and rusted metal catwalks.
It is completely silent, until an air raid siren wails from the mist at midnight.
Planet four has zero gravity and shifting black geometric monoliths.
You will never grow old, but within twenty-four hours, you will forget every memory you ever owned.
Which planet are you choosing? Tell me in the comments, before your shuttle touches down.
